docs.text:
passage: Dentist
Dr. Okafor, cleaning, Thursday March 14 at 9:30. Bring insurance card.

passage: Optometrist
New glasses check, Dr. Nair, Monday April 8 at 4:15 pm. Contacts prescription expires in May.
Ask about blue light lenses.

passage: Roasted tomato soup
1.5 kg ripe tomatoes, 1 head garlic, olive oil. Roast 40 min at 200C, blend with basil and a splash of cream. Freezes well.

passage: Shakshuka
Can of crushed tomatoes, 1 onion, 1 red pepper, cumin, paprika. Simmer 10 min, crack in 4 eggs, cover until set. Serve with pita. Needs feta.

passage: Lisbon, September
Flight lands 11:20 on the 9th. Stay in Alfama, 4 nights. Must do: tram 28, pastel de nata at Manteigaria, day trip to Sintra. Buy the Viva Viagem card.

passage: Kyoto ideas
Go in November for the maple leaves. Fushimi Inari early morning, bamboo grove in Arashiyama, a night in a ryokan with onsen. Rail pass for 7 days. Budget about 2400 euros.

passage: Oil change
Last done at 62,400 km in January. Next at 72,000. Synthetic 5W-30, filter from the Bosch shelf.

passage: Tires
Switched to winter tires on Nov 3. Pressure 2.4 bar front, 2.6 rear. Rotation due in spring; shop on Elm Street has a 20% coupon.

passage: Novels to read
- The Remains of the Day
- Piranesi
- A Gentleman in Moscow
Library hold on Piranesi ready soon.

passage: Nonfiction queue
Thinking in Systems, The Soul of a New Machine, Braiding Sweetgrass. Start with the middle one on the train. Notes go in the reading journal.

passage: Gift ideas: Mom
Birthday June 2. She mentioned a linen apron, the ceramic herb planter from the market, and a gardening class voucher. Budget 80.

passage: Gift ideas: Dad
Retires in October. Engraved pocket watch? Or the fly-fishing book plus waders. Ask Aunt Rosa what he already bought.

passage: Kitchen faucet
Drips. Replace the cartridge (Moen 1225), shut off valves under the sink first. Plumber's tape and a hex key in the garage drawer.

passage: Bathroom toilet keeps running
Flapper is probably worn. Buy a universal flapper (about 9 dollars) at the hardware store. Check the chain length, should have a little slack. Did this before in 2022 in the guest bathroom.

passage: Leg day, Tue
Squat 5x5 at 80 kg, Romanian deadlift 3x8 at 70, walking lunges 3x12. Knee felt fine. Add 2.5 kg next week.

passage: Run log
Sat: 8 km easy in 49 min. Wed: intervals, 6x400 m with 90 s rest. Sunday long run planned, 14 km. New shoes arrive Friday.

passage: Monday sync with the platform team
Release slips to the 22nd because the auth migration is not done. Priya owns the rollback plan. Ask Tomas about staging quota.

passage: Budget review, Q3
Marketing overspent by 12 percent. Cut the conference travel line, keep the design contractor. Finance wants a revised sheet by Friday. Next review in six weeks.

passage: Mochi vet visit
Annual shots and a dental check. Weight 4.3 kg, down 200 g. Switch to the senior kibble if she keeps losing. Next visit October.

passage: Biscuit grooming
Book the Saturday slot at Paws and Bubbles. Short trim, nails, ear cleaning. Cost 65. Flea treatment due on the 1st of each month.

passage: SSH tunnel to the db
ssh -N -L 5433:localhost:5432 deploy@bastion.example.com
Then connect psql to port 5433. Kill with Ctrl-C. Key is ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_work.

passage: Electric bill
94.30 due on the 18th. Usage up 15% since the heater went on. Autopay is off, pay by card on the website.

passage: Internet
Fiber plan 49.99 a month, price goes up to 69.99 in December unless I call and negotiate. Contract ends Nov 30. Router model is a TP-Link AX55.

passage: Groceries
[ ] oat milk
[ ] eggs
[ ] spinach
[ ] lemons
[ ] rice
[ ] dish soap

passage: Birthday party shopping (Sam, 12 guests)
[ ] two pizzas order by Friday
[ ] balloons
[ ] chocolate cake from Marta's bakery
[ ] paper plates and cups
[ ] sparkling cider

passage: Sourdough
Feed starter 12 hours before. 500 g flour, 350 g water, 10 g salt, 100 g starter. Stretch and fold every 30 min for 2 hours. Bake in a Dutch oven 20 min covered, 25 min open at 230C.

passage: Banana bread
3 overripe bananas, 75 g melted butter, 150 g sugar, 1 egg, 190 g flour, 1 tsp baking soda. 175C for 55 minutes. Walnuts optional. Grandma's trick: a spoon of yogurt.

passage: Spanish: ser vs estar
Ser for identity and permanent traits, estar for location and temporary states. Mnemonic: DOCTOR and PLACE. Practice 10 sentences before Thursday class.

passage: Python decorators
A decorator takes a function and returns a new function. Use functools.wraps to keep the name and docstring. Example: timing wrapper that prints elapsed seconds. Remember closures capture variables by reference.

passage: Password advice
Use a manager, one long passphrase for the vault, and turn on two-factor everywhere. Never reuse the email password. Print the recovery codes and keep them in the fire safe.

passage: Flu shot
At the pharmacy, any weekday after 5. No appointment needed. Bring the card. Skip if I have a fever.

passage: Plants
Monstera: water every 10 days. Fiddle leaf fig: only when top soil is dry. Succulents once a month. Fertilizer on the first Sunday.

passage: Piano practice
Scales 10 min, then Clair de Lune bars 1 to 16 hands separate. Metronome at 60. Teacher says relax the wrists. Lesson Wednesday.

passage: Journal, Sunday night
Felt scattered all week. Too many tabs open, in my head and on the screen. Next week: one big thing per day. Took a long walk by the river and it helped more than I expected.

passage: Landlord
Call about the radiator in the bedroom. Hissing and cold at the top. Mr. Haddad's number is in the contacts. Lease renewal letter also arrived.

passage: Car insurance
Renews March 3. Current premium 118 a month. Got a quote from Northgate for 96 with the same coverage. Call to cancel only after the new policy starts.

passage: Taxes
Gather: salary slips, donation receipts, the rent statement, health insurance form. Deadline April 15. Accountant Linda charges 150 flat. Book her by March.

passage: Book club
Last Friday of the month at Dana's. Next pick: a short story collection. Bring snacks, not wine, since Dana is off alcohol.

passage: Films to watch
Perfect Days, The Taste of Things, Past Lives, and that old Hitchcock about the bell tower. Rent one on Friday nights.

passage: Project idea
A tiny CLI that turns a folder of markdown notes into a weekly email digest. Use SQLite for state and cron for the schedule. Maybe 2 weekends of work.

passage: Garage cleanup
Donate the old bike and the paint cans. Hang shelves on the left wall with 4 brackets. Label bins: tools, camping, holiday. Saturday morning, 3 hours.

passage: Antihistamine
Take one cetirizine in the evening during pollen season, March to May. Do not combine with the cold syrup. Refill at the pharmacy when 5 pills are left.

passage: Emergency fund
Target: 6 months of expenses, about 14,400. Now at 9,100. Move 400 on the 1st of every month to the high-yield account.

passage: Wedding RSVP
Cousin Elena's wedding on August 23 in Porto. Reply by July 1. Hotel block code is on the invitation. Need a suit fitted, tailor is closed Mondays.

passage: Bike
Rear brake pads worn. Chain needs lube. Pump up to 60 psi. Shop on Harbor Road does a basic tune-up for 45.

passage: Parking permit
Renewal on the city website, need proof of address (utility bill) and registration. Costs 40 a year. Expires end of the month.

passage: Chicken stock
Carcass, onion, carrot, celery, bay leaf. Simmer 3 hours, never boil hard. Strain and freeze in 500 ml tubs.

passage: Camping checklist
[x] tent
[x] sleeping bags
[ ] headlamps
[ ] stove fuel
[ ] water filter
Book site at Pine Lake before the long weekend. Fire ban is likely.

passage: Physio
Shoulder exercises twice a day: band pull-aparts 3x15, wall slides 2x10. Ice if it aches. Follow-up with Jonas on the 28th.

passage: 1:1 with Sara
She wants to move to the data team next spring. Needs a mentor, suggested Ravi. I promised to write the recommendation by the 10th.

passage: Flat viewing
Saturday 11:00, Birch Street 14, third floor. Rent 1,350, deposit two months. Ask about heating costs and the pet policy.

passage: Coffee ratios
Pour over: 15 g coffee to 250 g water, 93C, 3 minutes. French press: coarser, 4 minutes. Beans from the Tamarind roaster are best within 3 weeks.

passage: Astronomy
Perseids peak on Aug 12. Drive to the hill past the reservoir, away from lights. Red flashlight, blanket, thermos. Moon sets around 1 am.

passage: Camera settings
Portraits: 85 mm, f/1.8, ISO 200. Street: 35 mm, f/8, zone focus at 3 m. Landscape: tripod, f/11, ISO 100, bracket 3 shots.

passage: Quote to remember
"Do the next right thing." Heard it from Uncle Ben at the funeral lunch. Put it on the fridge.

passage: Git undo
Undo last commit but keep changes: git reset --soft HEAD~1. Discard local edits to one file: git checkout -- file. Find a lost commit: git reflog.

passage: Docker cleanup
docker system prune -a --volumes frees disk space. Check usage first with docker system df. Don't run it on the build server during the day.

passage: Backup cron
0 3 * * * rsync -a --delete ~/Documents /Volumes/Backup/Documents. Check the log on Mondays. Disk is 2 TB, 60% full.

passage: Sleep
In bed by 23:00, no screens after 22:00. Magnesium glycinate with dinner. Room at 18C. Tracked average 6h40 last week, aim for 7h30.

passage: Aquarium
Water change 25% on Sundays. Test nitrate monthly. Feed the tetras once a day, only what they finish in 2 minutes. Algae on the left glass; add a nerite snail.

passage: Cacio e pepe
Pecorino, black pepper, pasta water. Toast pepper first. Take the pan off the heat before adding cheese or it clumps.

passage: Mushroom risotto
Arborio, shallot, white wine, hot stock added a ladle at a time, 18 minutes. Finish with butter and parmesan. Dried porcini soaked in warm water for the deep flavor.

passage: Refill
Thyroid pills, prescription expires Nov 30. Ask Dr. Weiss for 90-day supply. Lab work (TSH) due in October, fasting not needed.

passage: School meeting
Parent-teacher conference Thursday 18:30, room 12. Talk about reading level and the field trip permission slip. Bring Maya's drawings.

passage: Lawn
Aerate in September, overseed with fescue, then 1 inch of water per week. Mow high, about 8 cm. Neighbor Tom has a spreader I can borrow.

passage: Concert tickets
Low Tide Choir, Nov 9, doors 19:00 at the Armory. 2 tickets, section C, 64 each. Confirmation in email from the box office. Meet Hana outside at 18:15.

passage: Resume update
Add the migration project, quantify results (cut load time 40%). Drop the 2014 internship. Ask Priya to proofread. Portfolio link must go at the top.

passage: Hosting dinner
Saturday for four. Menu: burrata starter, lamb tagine, saffron couscous, pears poached in wine. Marcus is vegetarian, swap lamb for chickpeas for him.

passage: Flight check-in
BA 214 to Edinburgh, Friday 07:05. Check in online 24 hours before. One cabin bag only. Taxi booked for 04:45.

passage: Meditation
10 minutes each morning after coffee. Box breathing: in 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. Streak is 12 days.

passage: Learning Rust
Ownership: each value has one owner; moves transfer it. Borrowing with & is shared, &mut is exclusive. Finish chapter 4 of the book, then rewrite the word counter.

passage: Parcel
Pick up the parcel from Mrs. Alvarez, apartment 2B, she signed for it Tuesday. It's the printer ink.

passage: Return jacket
Return the blue jacket to the store by Oct 30, receipt in the glove box.

passage: Deep Work, notes
Block 2 hours in the morning with phone in another room. Shutdown ritual at 17:30. Track hours of focused work on a paper tally. Skeptical about the 4-hour ceiling.

passage: Haircut
Saturday 10:00 with Lucia. Same as last time, number 3 on the sides, scissors on top. Cash tip.

passage: Airline miles
Expire in December. 23,400 left. Enough for a short domestic flight; check the partner site for upgrade deals.

passage: Anniversary dinner, May 17
Booked Osteria Luna, 20:00, table by the window. Bring the photo album from 2019. Flowers: peonies, order from the shop on Pine by Thursday.

passage: Smoke detector
Replace batteries in the hallway smoke alarm; it chirps every minute. 9V batteries in the junk drawer. Test button monthly. Detector is 9 years old, replace unit at 10.

passage: Meal prep
Sunday: roast chickpeas and sweet potatoes, cook quinoa, wash greens, portion into 5 boxes.

passage: Boots resole
Cobbler on Mill Lane quotes 70 and ten days. Heel is fine, the left sole is peeling. Pick up before the first snow.

passage: Jury duty
Summons for Nov 12, report to the county courthouse at 8:00. Call the line the evening before to confirm. Employer letter requested.

passage: Birthdays
Anna Mar 3, Leo Mar 19, Grandpa Apr 2, Sofia Apr 28. Cards go out a week early.

passage: Sailing course
Take the weekend course at Harbor Club in June. 2 days, 240. Need non-slip shoes and a windbreaker. Instructor: Captain Ruiz.

passage: Router reset
Hold the pinhole button 10 seconds, then log in at 192.168.1.1. Default admin password is on the sticker underneath. Change SSID after.

passage: Tea notes
Sencha 75C for 1 minute, genmaicha 85C for 2, black tea 95C for 4. Do not oversteep green tea or it turns bitter.

passage: Donations
Set up monthly 25 to the food bank. Tax receipt arrives in January. Clothes bag to Goodwill drop-off behind the library.

passage: Presentation
Talk on Friday: 10 slides max, start with the customer story. Rehearse twice, time it under 12 minutes. Clicker is in the top drawer.

passage: Wine tasting notes
Rioja crianza 2019: cherry, vanilla, soft tannins. Good value at 14. Buy a case for the cabin trip.

passage: Laundry
Wash the wool sweater cold on delicate and dry flat. Never put the silk scarf in the dryer. Vinegar in the rinse for towels that smell damp.
